function.name: create-presentation
function.description: Create a new empty PowerPoint presentation.

function.name: add-slide
function.description: Add a slide by executing python-pptx code. The code should work with a `prs` variable already in scope.

code.description: Python code using python-pptx API to add a slide.

function.name: add-slide-from-skill
function.description: Add a slide using a skill from the library. The skill's create_slide() is automatically adapted.

skill_id.description: Skill ID from the library (use list-skills to find).

content_brief.description: Text content to inject (title, body text, etc.).

palette.description: Color palette control: '' (default dark tech), 'none' (keep skill colors), or JSON dict for custom palette.

function.name: replace-slide
function.description: Replace an existing slide with new code.

code.description: Python code for the replacement slide.

function.name: delete-slide
function.description: Delete a slide from the presentation.

function.name: save-presentation
function.description: Save the presentation to a PPTX file.

output_path.description: Absolute file path for the output .pptx file.

function.name: get-slide-info
function.description: Get information about a specific slide (shape count, types, text preview).

function.name: render-slide
function.description: Render a slide to base64 PNG. Requires LibreOffice.

function.name: list-skills
function.description: List or search skills in the library by category or name.

category.description: Filter by category (cover_divider, typography, animation, etc.).

query.description: Search query for skill name (substring match).

verified_only.description: Only show exec_ok=True skills (default true). Set false for cover/agenda/closing.

theme.description: Filter by theme: 'light' or 'dark'. Leave empty for all.

function.name: get-skill-info
function.description: Get detailed information about a specific skill (tags, usage, code preview).

skill_id.description: The skill ID to look up.

function.name: get-skill-code
function.description: Get the full Python code and visual technique description from a skill. Use to study visual techniques then write your own adapted code.

skill_id.description: The skill ID to get code from.

function.name: get-technique-snippet
function.description: Get a tested visual technique helper function. Available: gradient_fill, shadow, freeform_arc, radial_gradient_bg.

technique.description: Technique name: gradient_fill, shadow, freeform_arc, or radial_gradient_bg.

function.name: set-transition
function.description: Set a slide transition effect (fade, push, wipe, morph).

transition_type.description: Transition type: fade, push, wipe, or morph.

function.name: get-palette-preset
function.description: Get a theme palette preset. Available: dark_tech, clean_light, warm_corporate, bold_vibrant, ocean_calm. Call with no args to list all.

preset_name.description: Preset name, or empty to list all options.
